# nemau quota

Show the capacity limits applied to the target project.

A write is admitted only when both the project and the organization that owns
it have room. Each dimension gets one row, for the scope that will refuse
first: the one with the least headroom, which is not always the smallest
limit. Use --all-scopes to see every scope.

AVAILABLE subtracts pending reservations: capacity claimed by operations that
have been admitted but have not finished. That is what the platform compares a
new request against.

## Usage

```
nemau quota [flags]
```

Alias: `quotas`

## Options

```
      --all-scopes   show every scope, not only the one that binds
```

## Global options

```
      --api-url string           API origin (default: $NEMAU_API_URL, then https://api.nemau-cloud.com)
      --idempotency-key string   key making a write safe to repeat: 1-128 characters of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : - (default: generated)
  -o, --output string            output format: table, json (default "table")
      --project string           target project, by id or by name (default: $NEMAU_PROJECT_ID, then the saved project)
  -q, --quiet                    print ids only
      --timeout duration         how long to wait for one operation (default 30m0s)
      --wait                     wait for asynchronous operations to finish (default true)
```
